payload.title: The Detrended Stack
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook aims to reproduce the detrended stack and synthetic stack as described in a specific research paper. It requires pre-existing pickle files, which should be generated by running other notebooks in the 'Loading Data' folder. The notebook utilizes various Python libraries to process and visualize climate data, focusing on sorting data by latitude and plotting ensemble envelopes. The outputs include visualizations of the detrended and synthetic stacks.
goals: Reproduce the detrended stack from the paper
Reproduce the synthetic stack from the paper

section_blurbs.blurb: This section focuses on reproducing the detrended and synthetic stacks using preprocessed data. It involves sorting data by latitude and plotting ensemble envelopes with specific plot parameters and color palettes.
